entries.name: ZIIGAAT LUSH
entries.verdict: Precogvision lists it as a brief demo impression without a formal score (bias 4).
entries.quote: Dark and slow-sounding with a slight mid-treble peak. Competes with the Aful Explorer for the 'sleepy' award.

entries.name: ZIIGAAT ODYSSEY 2
entries.verdict: Precogvision lists it as a brief demo impression without a formal score (bias 5.5).
entries.quote: A bit too gritty and aggressive for my preferences. Bass has better focus/weight than Horizon though and big sound.

entries.name: Ziigaat Thunder
entries.verdict: Precogvision lists it as a brief demo impression without a formal score (bias 4).
entries.quote: A bit muddy sounding in the bass, on the more L-shape side with slightly better clarity than the Lush due to more treble.
